test_change_password_weak_new_password.details: Weak passwords (short, no uppercase, no number) return 400

test_change_password_success_and_revert.details: Valid change succeeds, login with new password works, reverted to original

test_forgot_password_success.details: Returns success message for existing email

test_forgot_password_nonexistent_email.details: Returns success for non-existent email (prevents enumeration)

forgot_password_link_visible.details: Forgot Password? link visible on login form

forgot_password_page_loads.details: Clicking link navigates to forgot password page with email input and submit button

settings_page_loads.details: Settings page loads after login with data-testid='profile-settings-page'

security_tab_exists.details: Security tab visible alongside Profile, Payment, Subscription, Notifications tabs

change_password_form_renders.details: Form has Current Password, New Password, Confirm Password fields and submit button

submit_disabled_empty_fields.details: Submit button disabled when fields empty

submit_enabled_valid_form.details: Submit button enabled when all requirements met

critical_code_review_comments: Password management implementation is complete and working correctly
Backend validates: auth required, current password, password strength (8 chars, uppercase, number), same password check
Frontend has proper form validation with real-time password strength checklist
Forgot password prevents email enumeration by always returning success
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
